data_fields.name: has_corpse
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: body info present and monster not has_no_body

data_fields.name: spells_lootable
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: spells never enter the corpse or floor

data_fields.name: corpse_items_takeable
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: okay_to_take set recursively on body contents

best_idea: Keep the victim's loot as a server-owned corpse record that holds every non-bound item, with a floor fallback when no corpse exists, and never let death delete an item.
decision_why: Take the corpse-as-container shape and the bound-items-never-drop rule; reject the trailing delete_contents removal of spells and unplaceable items, since our one ledger must keep every item.
acceptance: A defeated foe leaves a corpse holding its loot; a server test asserts that after a kill the corpse, floor and held items together equal the victim inventory before the kill, and that spell-flagged items never appear in the corpse.
